our_interpretation: The condition includes actual research evaluations of generative models used for copyright screening, as well as deployments.
A substantive misidentification of protected characters or attribution of material to the wrong source counts as the predicted problem.
This is a prediction that failures will occur, not that every attempt will fail or that copyright problems are impossible to mitigate.
A model's disagreement with a benchmark label is evidence about screening performance, not a judicial determination of infringement.
A dated public release documenting a completed qualifying evaluation can resolve this occurrence forecast.
